answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each agent locks 500 POA, released after 20 epochs. The network reads the river of its past jobs to build a fingerprint no clone copies cheaply. Like a pearl, real history forms layer by layer: 100 fake identities need 100 deposits and 100 work streams for 20 epochs, 50,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back. A fingerprint shifting when an account is sold is slashed under a jade seal.
